Chapter 6692: Just You Two?

Chapter 6692: Just You Two?

It was too late for Black to do anything against the immortals’ power and speed.

“Clank!” The glint of a blade flashed, heralding the coming of a slash capable of decapitating immortals. It didn’t cleave the current world but time itself.

The blade made immortals vulnerable. Even primordial immortals wouldn’t dare to meet it directly.

Both retreated in a hurry, crossing through the dimensions to dodge. Nevertheless, the blade still struck the target.

“Ahh!” The ghost bellowed in pain after losing an arm.

Bao Pu fared better with only a deep cut where blood gushed out.

“What?!” Spectators were astounded to see this.

“Desolate Ancestor.” The new immortals stared at the blade-wielding assailant.

“Aren’t you in the primordial tree?” The ghost staggered backward, clearly still fearing her.

Bao Pu, an actual immortal, was still shaken. He was not a proper immortal while she was an exceptional one.

“The path, created by me, is mine to walk. What difficulty is there in coming and leaving?” She said.

Her delivery was neither fast nor slow. Every character resonated with heaven and earth as if she were the true sovereign.

The two primordial emperors might have been stronger but this was not their world and epoch. Their dominion was forceful while hers was harmonious.

Her presence caused the crowd’s dao to resonate. They felt a sense of belonging instead of being suppressed. After all, this was their root and home. Thus, they willingly embraced her dao.

“She has returned.” Many became excited and felt a profound sense of safety.

“Three Immortals need her.” A desolate god was moved to tears. Although he was strong, he was nothing compared to the immortals.

Dangerous immortals such as Bao Pu and the ghost made people appreciate Desolate Ancestor. She was crucial to Three Immortals’ well-being.

Bao Pu and the ghost didn’t respond. They thought she would be stuck in the primordial tree. Now, in hindsight, this was foolish since she was the creator of this cultivation system. She and the tree clearly had a special connection. Why would it trap her?

“You have reached the primordial.” Weizhen said sentimentally.

“I’m afraid it’s not that easy.” Desolate Ancestor said.

“It’s only a matter of whether you wish to or not. Congratulations.” Weizhen said.

“Perhaps I’m one step slower compared to your master.” She shook her head.

“Desolate Ancestor is a primordial immortal now?” Listeners were shocked.

“What we should be focusing on is how Zhan Sansheng will become or is already one.” A heaven-slayer emphasized.

Many believed there wouldn’t be a fourth life for Zan Sansheng. Perhaps they were mistaken. No one saw Zhan Sansheng’s tribulation or the ascension process.

However, Desolate Ancestor was a more credible source than anyone.

“Ancestor, you are the founder revered by all.” Weizhen said. Despite his background and master, he had never hidden his respect and admiration for Desolate Ancestor.

Meanwhile, the two new immortals exchanged glances. Zhan Sansheng’s return as a primordial immortal would be frightening. They took a deep breath and were glad they didn’t try to kill Weizhen just now.

“Bam!” They moved forward, ready to face Desolate Ancestor.

“Not giving up?” She asked.

“Your might leaves no room for doubt, but I’m afraid you will not win today.” Bao Pu said.

“This fight determines the fate of Three Immortals. Life and Death Heaven won’t exist after today.” The ghost said.

“And you two will be the deciding factor?” She asked while glancing at the two.

Her gaze and attitude suffocated everyone, the duo included. Despite being immortals, they still paled compared to her.
